newsitem.title: NORWAY: Norwegian rescuers stop search for missing Germans.
newsitem.headline: Norwegian rescuers stop search for missing Germans.

text.p: Norwegian rescue services suspended a search for two German tourists missing since Thursday on a fishing trip in the North Sea, the Norwegian NTB news agency said on Sunday.
The men set off from Egersund, on the southwest coast of Norway, in a 15-foot (five-metre) boat. They were last seen at around 1700 GMT on Thursday, NTB said.

The boat and other equipment were found on Friday afternoon. Rescuers called off the two-day search on Saturday after more than 100 people scoured the coastline and area around where the boat was discovered.
According to rescue services, the men, aged between 25 and 40 years old, were not wearing life jackets, NTB said.
